Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mis-synthesized the gathered evidence by conflating co-authorship with common authorship. Despite correct findings that The Man in the High Castle is by Philip K. Dick and The Ganymede Takeover is by Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson, the Planner incorrectly concluded that both Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson “wrote both” works. This logical error (failing to identify the single common author) led to the wrong solution.
